claim: Table C.1 row: the DFIR Report is the threat report the Hancitor DLL flow cites, and supports its c4 class (neither stole data nor impeded systems).
quote:
Similar to a previous case, the threat actors were evicted before completing their
mission and as a result their final actions could not be observed.
issue: Adversarial read: the Hancitor DLL downloaded Ficker Stealer, an information stealer, but 'A successful connection from Ficker Stealer was not observed' (PDF p. 18), so no theft is reported. The flow cites this DFIR Report URL (from-zero-to-domain-admin). Holds.
